pages.raw_title: Strattec Security Corporation: Automotive Maker for Keys, Locks, Power Access Security
pages.raw_meta: Welcome to Strattec, headquartered in Milwaukee. We are one of the world's largest producers of automotive power access and security systems, locks and keys.
raw_blocks: We engineer the entire access experience
Rooted in our belief that access not only allows but also empowers, we deliver innovative, highly engineered access solutions that bring meaningful value to consumers.
Strattec. Where every journey starts with access.
From secure entry to effortless motion and confident closure, Strattec delivers intelligent, highly engineered access systems that feel intuitive, safe, and seamless at every interaction.
Combining generations of lock-craft experience, with the latest technologies giving customers new ways to access their vehicles.
Our power access systems simplify motion providing customers effortless experiences proven in real-world use.
Strattec latches are engineered to give drivers confidence in every close, delivering peace of mind through proven strength, precision, and safety OEMs trust.
As vehicles become more connected, intelligent, and experience‑driven, access is no longer an afterthought, it’s central to how drivers engage with their vehicles.

Strattec is continuously advancing access innovation to help OEMs integrate access more seamlessly into vehicle design and user experience while delivering differentiated solutions that evolve with consumer expectations.
Secure, connected access that enables convenient vehicle entry and control through RF/BLE/UWB technologies.
At Strattec, access is more than an entry point, it’s an experience. Our culture shapes how we innovate, collaborate, and deliver every day.
We don’t just make parts, we create the first and last touchpoint of every journey.
If you’re driven to think differently, collaborate deeply, and take ownership of meaningful work, you’ve found your home.

pages.raw_meta: At Strattec, we deliver a comprehensive range of "Smart" Vehicle Power Access and Electronic and Security Solutions.
raw_blocks: We’re the nimble, engineering-led, end-to-end access systems trusted partner.
Our Transformation to Fully Integrated Access Systems
Strattec’s story is rooted in a long tradition of lock‑craft, precision engineering, and manufacturing excellence.
For generations, we’ve helped shape how people securely and confidently access their vehicles—earning the trust of leading automotive OEMs through performance, reliability, and quality.

From our earliest days, Strattec has been defined by a deep understanding of access—not just as a function, but as a critical part of the vehicle experience. That foundation continues to guide how we engineer solutions today.

Strattec. Where every journey starts with access.
We engineer the access experience. Seamless, secure and safe.
To be the most trusted, global leader in safe and secure access solutions for the automotive and mobility industries by creating the ultimate access experience for consumers.
People, Integrity, Quality, Customer Focused, and Safety
We collaborate directly with engineering and design teams to solve complex access challenges, quickly, transparently, and with the depth to take ideas from concept to production.
Our presence enables us to work closely with customers across regions, aligning engineering, manufacturing, and quality to meet the demands of a global industry.
Wherever our partners operate, Strattec is positioned to deliver access solutions that perform reliably and integrate seamlessly.

pages.raw_meta: STRATTEC Aftermarket Solutions provides OEM quality locks and keys to the automotive aftermarket through highly developed, independent distribution channels. Learn more here.
raw_blocks: Equipping locksmiths to build better customer satisfaction with quality, reliability & technical support.
Strattec Aftermarket Solutions provides OEM quality locks and keys to the automotive aftermarket through highly developed, independent distribution channels.

Strattec proudly offers the latest technology smart keys, push button fobs, transponder keys, remote head keys and related lock products. If you call an automotive locksmith at midnight, chances are he'll bring products and expertise from Strattec’s Aftermarket Solutions.
